source: Mirrors the numbered actionable todos in ROADMAP.md (root) - keep both in step.
order: Pane order is computed, not numeric: topological by deps, then priority, then cost, then n.

features.title: Realtime push (SSE): sessions, signals, boats without polling
Rankings / leaderboard across boats in a session
Replay: per-session playback with leaderboard snapshot
Auth: replace the bare MAC header identity
Screen capture in bands so it works on a prod-connected device
Persist simulated runs (wiped by every Render redeploy today)
Gun banner and audio cue at the start
Store GPS of mock boats while a session is live
Sessions pane: status filter plus calendar
Hide committee controls unless the session is live
Remove pursuit offsets (all boats start on the same gun)
Race finishes on the line cross, only after every mark is cleared
Race-screen variant focused on the next target
